_comment: Church-LAN probe target registry for the on-church-network agent runner. DECLARATIVE, read-only. The runner (homed on the church-side NAS) probes ONLY these devices, ONLY with the read-only `probe` kind named here (scripts/lib/church-lan-probe.mjs :: PROBE_KINDS). It can LOOK but never TOUCH. Any `ip` left as SME-CONFIRM is reported `unknown` in the snapshot and is NEVER fabricated -- fill it in once the real address is captured into the COLG device asset register (docs/99-session-notes/2026-06-29-colg-church-device-asset-register.md). Design note: docs/99-session-notes/2026-06-29-on-church-network-agent-runner-design.md. SHIPS INERT: nothing here arms anything; the runner stays behind the Cage brakes (infra/church-runner/brakes.sh) and ships with the kill-switch engaged.

targets.label: Church NAS (tlcrackstation) -- the runner host
targets.note: Synology RackStation the runner is homed on (24/6.5, not livestream-bound). SME-CONFIRM model + LAN IP. The probe self-checks it is reachable on its own LAN segment.

targets.label: Tailnet peer reachability (church <-> home)
targets.note: Host-local read of `tailscale status` -- confirms which church + home peers are online so Darrell can drive from anywhere. No IP needed.

targets.label: UniFi network controller
targets.note: Read-only client/port list (who is on the wire, IPs, PoE state). SME-CONFIRM controller URL + a read-only API key (key supplied at runtime from .env, never in git). UniFi controller mentioned awaiting-input in infra/ai-orchestrator/README.md.

targets.label: Blackmagic ATEM switcher
targets.note: Reachability + RTT. SME-CONFIRM presence + IP (no ATEM documented in repo yet -- presence unconfirmed).

targets.label: Lenovo Legion (left) -- NDI -> HDMI bridge box
targets.note: The left tower bridges NDI -> HDMI into the wall path. Also a CUDA GPU worker (church-cuda / church-tower) the runner can dispatch AI-idle-only work to. SME-CONFIRM IP.

targets.label: OBS box (right) -- streaming PC / gpu worker
targets.note: The right tower runs OBS/streaming and is the second CUDA GPU worker. SME-CONFIRM IP. Livestream-first; AI dispatch is idle-only and stands down Sundays (DR-0012).

targets.label: NDI discovery (sources on the wire)
targets.note: Lists NDI sources visible on the LAN -- the direct answer to 'what NDI is actually on the wire'. SME-CONFIRM the NDI Discovery Server host (or use mDNS browse). Pairs with lib/ndi-output.js + the program-output bridge.

targets.label: NovaStar VX1000 LED-wall processor
targets.note: Reachability only (the VX1000 is HDMI/DVI-fed, not NDI-native; signal path in 2026-06-24-sanctuary-wall-novastar-vx1000-signal-path.md). SME-CONFIRM whether its management NIC is on the LAN + IP.
